name: PopulateTextFieldInWindow
label: Populate Text Field in Window
description: Fills a text box or editable field in a window with the specified text using the method you choose.

fields.name: IdentificationObjectPath
fields.label: UI Element
fields.description: The UI element for the text box or editable field you want to fill.

fields.name: TextToEnter
fields.label: Text to Enter
fields.description: The text to populate the text field with.

fields.name: FillMethod
fields.label: Fill Method
fields.description: Choose how to fill the text field (Type, Paste, or Set Value).

selectOptions.label: Type
selectOptions.description: Type the text into the field.

selectOptions.label: Paste
selectOptions.description: Paste the text into the field.

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait to find the UI element (in seconds).

fields.name: IsTextFilled
fields.label: Is Text Filled Successfully
fields.description: Indicates whether the text was filled successfully.
